title: eval-harness: add prompt-regression CI hook with per-prompt thresholds and metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: provide a guarded CI hook that runs the eval-harness against changed prompt-sets and associated thresholds, preventing silent prompt regressions from reaching main. This PR introduces a lightweight CI hook + CLI integration that: 1) detects modified prompt-set directories, 2) runs eval-harness with per-prompt acceptance thresholds (yaml), 3) uploads aggregated eval metrics to the internal metrics service and posts a summarized check to the PR, and 4) fails the CI check when thresholds are violated (with a manual override label allowed for emergency merges). The change is backwards-compatible: if no thresholds file is present, default global thresholds are applied. Also included: docs and examples for adding new prompt-sets and configuring thresholds. Checklist: - [x] hook CLI and GitHub Action workflow - [x] per-prompt threshold parser and schema validation - [x] metric upload integration (+ retry/backoff) - [x] human-readable PR summary and links to detailed metrics - [x] tests for threshold enforcement and edge cases - [x] docs updated under docs/eval-harness/prompt-gating Related: ENG-4821 (prompt regression program), PM-112 (quality gating product requirement). See design note: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821/prompt-regression-ci-hook. Migration: repo maintainers should add a thresholds.yml when adding new prompt-sets. Operational notes: CI hook runs timed-out after 25m by default; heavy suites can opt into sample-based evaluation via opt-in config. Security: metrics uploaded contain only numeric eval summaries and hashed prompt-set identifiers.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Jordan Lee on 2025-03-01 after CI green and 2 approvals. Squash commit: feat(eval): eval-harness CI hook + thresholds (summary). PR closed and tracking Linear items moved to In Review.
release_notes: Adds a CI hook that runs eval-harness against changed prompt-sets and enforces per-prompt thresholds defined in thresholds.yml. Uploads eval metrics to internal metrics service and posts a summarized PR check. Maintainers should add thresholds for new prompt-sets. See docs for configuration.
notes_for_maintainers: The GitHub Action uses 25m timeout by default. Long-running prompt suites should use the sampling opt-in config or bump the action timeout. To bypass the gate in emergencies add label 'ci/allow-fail' and follow the emergency merge playbook. Metrics uploader retries 3 times with exponential backoff and logs failures to infra-monitoring.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy failures for large prompt suites or flaky metrics endpoint. Mitigation: discovery to skip unrelated PRs, sampling opt-in, retry/backoff for uploads, and an explicit override label for incident merges.
